posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Visionary Tempest Haka AZ Unity vs. Advanced Ambuscade.

Despite some terrible mental errors by the user (Wrest the Mind on Explosives Launcher, and then dropping it to 3hp and destroying the cloaking device, thinking AZ could finish off the launcher) creating risk of defeat, a WtM on an Explosives Wagon sealed victory.

Apparently there was some confusion in the app, Wrest the Mind was redirecting the Wagon's damage, but it wasn't dealing damage to the wagon or visionary, so instead of a low hp Ambuscade and an incapped Visionary we had Amby incapped with no damage to Vis.

Also Champion Bot + Cryo Bot plus an exploding wagon is awesome.

 

Game #2 was a horrible defeat, had the match in the bag when Amby pulled his cloaking device.  Then Sustain the portal set off two Explosives Wagons and the heroes all wiped from the mid-teens in health.

It was a perfect storm to ruin a match that was in the bag.

 

EDIT:  That's what I get for trying to pull off two real quick.  Oh well, suck it Ambuscade!
